alt: A short film with no voice and no text on screen except the last card, with music. A dim room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes on the left leans toward a table lamp and it lights up, and a warm glow fills the room. It leans again toward a mug next to the lamp and steam begins to rise. A light blue figure walks in from the right with narrowed, tired eyes, sees the glow and the steam, and its eyes go wide and then happy and it pulses. The amber one smiles. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
